summary: Kim, a Korean war orphan, proudly displays a sweater with his name embroidered on the breast, presented to him by Miss Gladys Moncrieff, a leading Australian singer. Kim has been adopted by the staff at the British Legation, Seoul, the residence of the Commander in Chief of the British Commonwealth Forces in Japan and Korea.
